name: Uridium Plus
summary: Uridium+ sends you back into a desperate mission where you systematically assault enormous enemy dreadnoughts draining entire planets. You first fight through interceptor waves and heavy defenses before landing directly on the enemy structure to strike at its core. There you extract vital energy resources under constant pressure, knowing that escape requires one final dangerous attack run. Rearranged stages and the freedom to land at any time increase the pace and make the challenge feel sharper and more intense.
